text:
zoe: heads-up: I'm consolidating the relnotes for the embeddings v2 rollout. Need a short migration example, link fixes, and a 'what changed' bullet for the changelog.
frank: which files should we update?
zoe: sdk/js/embeddings.md, sdk/python/embeddings.md, guides/migrations/embeddings-v2.md, and changelog/2026-03. Also sweep for absolute links to vendor docs and any anchors that changed after the repo restructure.
cheng: I'll handle the anchors and canonicalize external links to docs.redwood.ai. Found a couple of legacy anchors in guides/ that moved under /guides/embedding-patterns/ — I'll patch them.
gretchen: i'll rewrite the snippets to show the new batch-friendly API (batchSize param) and the deprecated field mapping: old 'input' -> new 'inputs' (array). small BEFORE/AFTER please.
zoe: perfect. include a one-line compatibility note: "old single-input calls still work but are deprecated; bulk calls are preferred for lower per-item overhead." Also add a Known issue: "Similarity scores may change slightly due to switched normalization in v2; users should rebaseline thresholds."
cheng: replaced three broken anchors and switched two absolute vendor links to canonical docs.redwood.ai/vendor-plugins. Pushed to my branch.
docs-bot: New PR created: #5627 by gretchen - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5627
gretchen: sample snippets I'm adding. JS BEFORE/AFTER: 
```js
// BEFORE (single-input, old param)
const v = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'emb-v1', input: text })
// AFTER (v2, batch inputs + batchSize)
const batch = [text, text2]
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'emb-v2', inputs: batch, batchSize: 16 })
const vectors = resp.data
```

python BEFORE/AFTER: 
```py
# BEFORE
vec = client.embeddings.create(model='emb-v1', input=text)
# AFTER
batch = [text, text2]
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='emb-v2', inputs=batch, batchSize=16)
vectors = resp['data']
```
frank: add a tiny code diff box in the changelog (people scan code snippets first). Also include the deprecation warning and the migration timeframe.
zoe: timeline: deprecation warning goes in relnotes; we plan to soft-deprecate for 60 days, then error on the old param after the next minor. Add migration steps: 1) switch to inputs array, 2) set batchSize tuned to workload, 3) re-evaluate thresholds.
gretchen: added unit tests that call the helper wrapper and validate response shape; CI run now.
cheng: small note: I saw a reference to max_tokens_embed in one migration doc. We renamed that param to max_tokens across SDKs — will update text and anchors.
zoe: great catch. Also add a pointer to Optimize -> batching guide for tuning batchSize.
frank: Known issues bullet to include in relnotes: "Some third-party similarity tooling assumes pre-v2 normalization; customers may see small false positives/negatives until retrained."
gretchen: PR #5627 updated with snippets, tests, and changelog entry. CI started.
docs-bot: CI passed for #5627 — ready for review.
zoe: I'll do a quick editorial pass and merge if no blockers. If anything fails in the snippet playground, revert quickly.
frank: :shipit:
zoe: thanks all. tagging resolved after merge.
